title: Amajwi ari iruhande y'amazi atekanye
intro: Iyumvire umuryango utavuzwe kubera igisagara canke umutware, ahubwo wari uzwi kubera amazi atagiramwo ubuzima yari akikuje. Imirongo mikeyi gusa ni yo yibuka uwo mugwi, wama uri ku rutonde rw’abanka ubuyobozi. Umviriza uko bavuga bari mu mwijima.
clues: Turi umuryango witwa muri Korowani, yamara inkuru yacu yose iguma itwikiriwe n’akabanga.
Twama tuvugwa iruhande y’abahakana, nk’abantu ba Ad na Thamud.
Twitwa Abagenzi ba Ar-Rass, Iriba ubuzima bwacu bwabosheko.
Twarahakanye intumwa yaturungikiwe ifise ubuyobozi butomoye.
Turaharurwa mu banse intumwa zose zarungitswe na Allah.
Twarahanganye n’iterabwoba ryarangutse ku muhakana wese yari imbere yacu, ugutikizwa kubera ukwanka kwacu.

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
